name: Kanbayashi Urara
source:
Goddess of Matchmaking

A young goddess of fate and future who suddenly appeared before Hajime and warned him that he was going to be a virgin for life. She is bright, lively, and always smiling. She’s also a real chatterbox, and her mouth runs a mile a minute.

Urara has been assigned to closely observe the unprecedented case of a person who used so many love charms that he managed to break causality.

She possesses a wide range of divine powers, such as the ability to fly, turn invisible, walk through walls, and communicate via telepathy. In order for her to observe Hajime closely, she also uses her powers to convince people that she’s his younger sister, so she can watch over him while he chooses his future bride.

[spoiler]She was actually supposed to be born as Hajime's sister but a change of fate caused her to never be born and Urara became a goddess instead. Using her goddess powers makes the world the way it was supposed to be, with her being Hajime's true sister again.[/spoiler]

Her legal documents are obviously fake, but she’s a goddess, so she’s not bound by the laws of our world.

Though she gave Hajime the gift of destiny count and pulled a few strings to help him transfer schools, her job is primarily to observe him. Beyond that, she only gives him advice when she feels so inclined.

When it comes to sex, she’s up for anything.
She can be seductive and cheeky, but that’s only because she doesn’t see herself as a potential love interest. She’s the kind of girl who’d fold easily if you got serious with her.

She has no insecurities, no complaints, and no fears.
